classic_rfm_result.verdict: Largest cluster holds 54.3% of customers — recency and monetary carry enough real variation on their own that classic RFM does not collapse into one dominant blob the way the 97% frequency=1 finding alone might suggest. But cluster balance was never the actual limitation: R, F and M contain zero delivery or review information by construction, so no value of k lets this model ever find a delivery-quality segment — that requires features that were never given to it. Confirmed below by comparison: the extended feature set below finds a 6.6%-of-base cluster with a 99% late-delivery rate that classic RFM has no way to detect at any k.
